notes.title: 1.5.10 Enhancements to the Plot System
notes.content:
1. Improved the new player guidance process  
2. Added a new dialogue system for plot progression. New storylines include "First Entry into the Game," "First Return to Valhalla," and "Rescuing the Valkyrie."  
3. Optimized and adjusted game values  
4. Enhanced the lighting performance of scenes and fixed an issue where some terrain was unaffected by lighting  
5. Fixed an issue where volume control was unresponsive under certain conditions  
6. Resolved a bug where the Baby Dragon’s actual attack frequency did not match the skill settings  
7. Added a progress bar to the Resonance interface; when the bar is full, the "Rescuing the Valkyrie" storyline is triggered  
8. Redesigned the weapon shop mechanics: players can now spend Soul Stones to smelt existing weapons into specified weapons, rather than purchasing them directly.

notes.title: Update to Version 1.5.9 on August 10, 2025
notes.content:
1.Added 5 new straight swords, 5 new greatswords, and introduced a new weapon type: [Slender Sword], along with 4 corresponding weapons.

2.Added 11 new spears.

3.Added a new enemy type: Lava Warlock.

4.Added a new boss: Mutant Giant.

5.Added a new enemy type: Hellhound.

6.Added a new enemy type: Venomous Scorpion.

7.Added a new enemy type: Night Elf.

8.Players now receive a blessing that restores HP upon successfully triggering a parry.

9.Optimized the performance of existing weapons.

10.Implemented the Graphics Quality Settings feature.

notes.title: [1.5.1] All-New Systems & Levels
notes.content:
1.The brand-new [Familiar System] is now available! This young Fire Dragon will follow players into battle.

2.New Maps: [Forgotten Tundra] and [Sea at the World's End].

3.Added several new powerful spell blessings.

4.Added a new Boss: [Corrupted Centaur].

5.Optimized the [Weapon System]: Weapons can now be upgraded after obtaining duplicates. Weapon details will be displayed when near dropped weapons.

6.Added a character panel for viewing detailed character attributes and blessings.

notes.title: New weapon! Staff
notes.content: Added 9 new staff weapons.  Fixed the BUG where some blessings were not working.  Optimized the BOSS shop function.  Enhanced the main character's base stats and health growth.  Added damage statistics.

notes.title: Update log
notes.content:
April 14,2025: Updated the transmission transition animation and optimized the hit response when invulnerable.  Improved the UI display of health bars and focus values.  Reduced the health of the Stone Man and increased double resistance.  Enhanced weapon frame stability.  Reduced the attack range of the War Axe 1A and decreased health consumption.  Partially replaced BUFF icons.  Optimized in-game item drop behavior for easier pickup.  Added physical interaction to treasure chests to prevent getting stuck

April 6, 2025: Added two new monsters, skeleton soldiers and stone men.  Added multiple waves of small monsters in boss battles.  Adjusted the probability of appearance of high-level monsters, resource output, and weapon prices
